description: Return the content of one public page of justautomate.ai as clean Markdown (no navigation, scripts or forms), with title, description and canonical URL in the front matter. Accepts a full URL or a path such as "/uslugi/" or "/en/services/process-workshop/". Old addresses are followed to their current page. Private client offers and pages excluded from search engines are not available.

url.description: Page URL on justautomate.ai or a path starting with "/".

name: get_page
title: Read a page of justautomate.ai
